comments.author: mashdoopster
comments.body_html:
Hi - so before downloading this mod I had this issue….where once i click on the “Tasks” option, I can longer access any of the others. They seem to glitch out. I thought this mod might help that but it evidently isn’t meant to address it.

I was wondering whether you had heard of other people having this issue, and if there is a fix. Otherwise it might simply be an issue created by some other mod and I’ll need to do a deeper dive into identifying and uninstalling the problem mod.

Thanks.

comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html: mashdoopster that issue is caused by removing a mod that adds custom quests. Once you use a mod with custom quests, you are required to keep using that mod forever on that profile to avoid potential issues such as what you’re seeing

comments.author: mashdoopster
comments.body_html:
Ok - If I removed a mod like that, would adding it back fix this issue? I tried doing that but still encountering it.

Edit: I believe I know which mod it was I removed. It was a new trader with new quests, like you said. It doesn’t seem like adding that back helped the issue, so I’m wondering if it is now a permanent issue on this profile. Have you heard of people being able to fix this?

Edit 2: Continued troubleshooting and found another trader mod i had forgotten about. Redownloaded it. Now the issue is fixed.

TLDR: If selecting the “Tasks” option creates inability to select other menu options, reinstalling all trader/new quest mods that had been deleted can fix this.
